description: FHWA Federal Lands Highway Divisions is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). The FHWA Federal Lands Highway Divisions dataset is as of July 17, 2025 from the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). This dataset depicts the areas covered by the three FHWA Federal Lands Highway Division Offices. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). Its keywords are USA, National, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, National, Transportation, Atlas, Database. The bounding box given is -179.1473,17.8812,179.7785,71.3904. The hub shows 2026-08-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
